output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf target is increased by mintedAmount, and totalSupply is also increased by mintedAmount. If mintedAmount is large, the balanceOf target can overflow and become very small, making the user unable to transfer funds.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls transfer, the balanceOf msg.sender is decreased by _value, and balanceOf _to is increased by _value. If _value is large, the balanceOf msg.sender can overflow and become very small, making the user unable to transfer funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls transferFrom, the balanceOf _from is decreased by _value, and balanceOf _to is increased by _value. If _value is large, the balanceOf _from can overflow and become very small, making the user unable to transfer funds.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls buy, the amount is set to msg.value / buyPrice. If buyPrice is very small, msg.value / buyPrice can overflow and become very large, allowing the user to buy a large amount of tokens for a very small amount of ether.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls sell, the amount is set to balanceOf msg.sender. If balanceOf msg.sender is large, amount can overflow and become very small, allowing the user to sell a large amount of tokens for a very small amount of ether.
